texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]上曾经居住着某个智力较为发达的外星物种，或许再过几十年就能够研发出太空旅行，但在那之前他们就已经把自己终结了。虽然星球本身已经从毫无意义的大肆毁灭中恢复了过来，但表面上仍然有十分明显的伤疤。

地表上残存着几处遗迹，其中有座保存得较为良好的石碑。[Root.GetLeaderName]十分轻松地解读了上面的讯息，原来是世界末日的幸存者们为后来之人所刻下的一则警告。其种族灭亡的直接原因便是“终极武器”的发明。这个种族的某种心理学特征导致共同毁灭机制不再有效。

因为最终武器很难被摧毁，那些最终由于不明原因迅速死去的幸存者们在临死前便将其藏在了地底深处，并留下讯息劝告后人不要去寻找它们。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] was once home to a race of reasonably intelligent beings who destroyed themselves when they were seemingly only decades away from space flight. The planet has recovered from what must have been immense acts of senseless destruction, but it still bears very visible scars.

One of the few remaining ruins on the surface holds a reasonably well-preserved stone monolith inscribed with a message, quickly decoded by [Root.GetLeaderName]. It is a warning, from the last of the extinct species to whoever they believed would arise after their passing. It was the development of an "ultimate weapon" that was their downfall; some quirk in the psychology of this species evidently rendered deterrence through mutually assured destruction impossible.

Survivors, before dying of unknown causes soon after, hid this weaponry deep underground as destroying them was difficult, and left this message dissuade us from going looking for them.

label.zh: 那我们还是别去找了吧。

texts.zh:
看起来这颗星球上的“最终武器”只不过是我们眼中最为基本的武器科技而已。

他们能运用这些科技导致世界末日，或许只是因为十分爱好杀戮而已吧。
texts.en:
It seems the people of this planet were experimenting only with what we would consider to be fairly basic weapons technologies.

The havoc they wrought is more a testament to their incredible, genocidal tenacity than it is to the power of their weaponry.

label.zh: 对于[Root.Owner.GetName]来说，都没什么用处。
label.en: None of this is of any use to the [Root.Owner.GetName].

texts.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为幸存者们隐藏武器的决定十分正确。在地底洞穴中找到的这些武器虽然与[Root.Owner.GetName]的现役装备原理相同，但更为先进。这些科技一定会对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]战争机器大有帮助。
texts.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] remarks that the previous inhabitants of this place were right to hide these weapons, recovered from a cave beneath the ruins, away. They build on the same basic principles as weapons already in use in the [Root.Owner.GetName], but are far more advanced. These technologies are sure to be a boon to the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] military machine.

label.zh: 什么？我们已经有这些科技了。
label.en: What? We already possess this technology.

label.zh: 升级我们的质量投射器。

texts.zh: 搜查无果。不管是怎样强大的武器，现在都没了。
texts.en: The search proves fruitless. Whatever these mystical weapons were, they are now gone.

texts.zh: 在这个星球的某个地方藏匿着一个武器箱。如果我们能找它，也许我们的帝国可以借此获得新的武器技术。
texts.en: A cache of weapons lie hidden somewhere on the planet. If we can find them, they may provide new martial technologies for our Empire.
